summary.text: Aiden "Addie" Swallow is the Democratic candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Swallow described herself as a 19-year Army veteran who served as a human intelligence collector and counterintelligence special agent, and listed expanding AHCCCS and fully funding rural clinics as her primary focus.

paragraphs.text: Swallow began serving in the U.S. Army in 2007.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was raised in poverty, served in Iraq and Afghanistan, and ended her career as an intelligence and leadership instructor at Fort Huachuca.
She said she entered politics after the 2025 inauguration under the campaign theme "Real Solutions for Rural Arizona."
Swallow said her priorities include public education, saying she supports regulating Empowerment Scholarship Account vouchers, and protecting Arizona water for state residents.
She also said she would pursue a legislative initiative she calls Arizona SHIELD, intended to supplement AHCCCS coverage and services.
